name: Skip
brief: A jump rope training app. People use it to plan and time rope sessions, count jumps, and see their progress over weeks.

screens.prompt: Home screen: today's planned session, the current streak, this week's progress toward the weekly goal, and one clear way to start.
Training history page: jumps per week as a chart, then the past sessions as a list with date, duration, jumps and best run without a miss.

Session timer: runs today's session. Before starting: what is about to happen and one way to start. While running: the countdown, the round, a way to count jumps, pause and finish. When done: a summary and where to go next.
prelude: every 1s when phase=="done" && !saved -> emit finish_session count; saved=true
screens.preludeNote: This screen's state and clock are already written by the host (below): do not write state or every lines. phase is one of "ready", "set" (a 3 second count-in), "work", "rest", "done". Start by setting phase="set"; finish by setting phase="done" (the host then emits finish_session). left is the seconds left in the phase, round the round number, count the jumps, paused whether the clock is held, elapsed the seconds moved, saved whether the result is stored. Show different things by phase with if lines.

contract.note: Every screen reads these variables and calls these actions. They already exist with these sample values: do not declare them with state, and do not invent other data. Declare with state only what this screen alone needs (which tab is open).

actions.open_history: Go to the training history page
actions.open_session: Open one past session (pass its date)
actions.finish_session: End the session (pass the jump count)

rules: One phone screen 390 wide and about 844 tall, one column, the most important thing first. If the design system has a Screen block, it is the root (it scrolls and paints the page); otherwise write the root as Column scroll.
Use the design system's components and text styles; write no colors of your own except where data needs one.
Every button calls one of the contract's actions with emit, or changes state on this screen.
No images by URL and no emoji. Use Icon with a Material icon name.
